text:
GENERATE BURST CS9-cloudtex-a — Run C-9 P5, the CLOUD-BANK TEXTURE for the cliffside canyon (Matt R-C9-21: "implement the clouds from the prior cliffside scene — the opaque ones which were purpose built to explain the cliff's detail and which were made to look like real clouds"). task_id "CS9-cloudtex-a".

Paint ONE 1536x1024 image ENTIRELY filled, edge to edge, with a dense, opaque bank of billowing valley cumulus seen from above at a high three-quarter angle, lit by a warm SUNSET from the UPPER-LEFT: rose-peach and warm cream on the lit billow tops, soft lavender and dusky violet in the shadowed hollows between billows, a few thin wisps. They must READ AS REAL CLOUDS — believable volume, soft light and shadow, natural irregular billows — rendered in our register (the REGISTER CARD above): a hand-painted watercolor-and-ink look with soft uneven washes and a fine, light pen line only where a billow edge needs it; never flat cartoon puffs, never a photograph. IMAGE 1 is GEOMETRY-ONLY: the approved cloud bank from the earlier scene — match its cloud forms, billow scale and density, NOT its style or colours. IMAGE 2 is our painted style (line and washes only; not its content).
CONSTRAINTS: no sky, no ground, no rock, no trees, no horizon, no empty gaps — clouds fill 100 % of the frame; billows roughly uniform in scale across the frame (each billow head about 120-260 px wide), no single dominant feature, NO two billows alike; the LEFT and RIGHT edges must tile seamlessly; even overall brightness top to bottom (no vignette, no gradient to dark). No characters, text, UI, border.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if the frame is not fully filled with clouds, a sky/horizon/ground appears, the clouds read as flat cartoon puffs, or the left/right edges clearly do not tile — name the reason. Copy the output to out/cloudtex_a.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS9-cloudtex-a"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — GEOMETRY-ONLY: the approved cloud bank (forms, billow scale, density); a different style — copy nothing else
IMAGE 2 — our painted style (line and washes only; not its content)
